I found two password reset emails, and they don't match, so I'd use only the first one.

**1. Likely legitimate (from support@techservices.com, subject "TechServices Password Reset Request")**
https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?asfbuy3y2cdaqhvei

**2. Suspicious (from tech-services-password@aol.com, subject "Your TechServices password reset request")**
This one contains two different links, including https://www.password-reset-12bh12.com, which is not a TechServices domain, and https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?fjahwb24jab3. The sender is a personal AOL address, not a techservices.com address. I'd avoid clicking anything in this email. It may be a phishing attempt.

I also didn't request a reset in either case, as far as I can tell from the emails. If you didn't ask for one, you may want to ignore both and check your account security with TechServices directly.
